query:
-- Crear tabla autodiagnosticos
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS autodiagnosticos (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INT NOT NULL,
  fecha TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  porcentaje_total DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  porcentaje_categoria_1 DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  porcentaje_categoria_2 DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  porcentaje_categoria_3 DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  porcentaje_categoria_4 DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  porcentaje_categoria_5 DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'en_progreso' NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

-- Crear tabla requirements
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requirements (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  categoria INT NOT NULL,
  categoria_nombre VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  codigo VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  descripcion TEXT NOT NULL,
  articulo_nom VARCHAR(100),
  orden INT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

-- Crear tabla evidences
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS evidences (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  autodiagnostico_id INT NOT NULL,
  requirement_id INT NOT NULL,
  cumple BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  evidencia_url TEXT,
  evidencia_nombre VARCHAR(255),
  observaciones TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (autodiagnostico_id) REFERENCES autodiagnosticos(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (requirement_id) REFERENCES requirements(id)
);
